reasoning: Within the last 45 days there are no Nevada-specific 2026 Senate or presidential general-election polls from qualifying outlets, so there is no current, numerically defined D+ or R+ margin I can defensibly assign for either race. Given the lack of state-level polling and the fact that Nevada is structurally close to EVEN but slightly Democratic-leaning by PVI, the fairest characterization is that both the statewide Senate and presidential environments remain essentially tied, with no clear polling advantage for either party at this time.
